notes: Only two of the seven bullets are things you do outside the battlefield: trade the silver piece, then go click the Cutter. Everything from bullet 4 on happens inside an escort battle and none of it can carry a marker. Bullet 3 (a 30 minute limit) is a rule of the fight, not a step, and folds into the Cutter step's note. Bullet 7 is the reward chest -- an outcome of the painter finishing, not an action, and the chest contents are the header's Reward list, so nothing there is evidence. The walkthrough refuses to name the painter ('you will find a NPC who will ask you to open the door for her'); only the header's Description calls her Faluuya, and even then she is not what you interact with -- the door is, and the door is unnamed. So that step's target is honestly none. The page also never names the battlefield interior as a zone and the client has no zone called Ashu Talif, so the interior steps stay in Arrapago Reef, which is where you must be to reach them. Fame reads 'Treasures of Aht Urhgan', the expansion's name rather than a region's, but it is the Aht Urhgan fame area and the resolver folds it to aht_urhgan; FLevel is empty so it gates nothing either way. The 24 hour repeat cooldown is invisible to the addon.

steps.note: the header writes the item twice, as its short name and its long one. Once every 24 hours, which nothing in the packets reports.

the door the painter asks you to open. The walkthrough names neither her nor the door -- only the header's Description calls her Faluuya -- so there is nothing to target. Get the whole party ready before opening it.

they spawn continuously and ignore players, rushing the painter instead; damaging one makes it aggro you. She must be kept alive -- if she dies the mission is over -- and she can be cured. Hurt, she runs to the back of the ship until whatever is on her is dead.

optional: the quest ends when the painting is finished whether or not he dies. He appears shortly after the crew start spawning, on the far side of the hull from where you entered; killing him despawns the crew, stops the spawns, and makes a second treasure chest appear on deck.

notes: A weapon skill quest, and the page has a hole in it: bullet 2's 'Breaking the Latent' sub-bullet is a transclusion (the front matter flags it) and this render carries the heading with no body, so the actual latent condition -- the bulk of the quest by time spent -- is simply not on the page. It is kept as a rung anyway because the page really does put an action between two Brutus steps, and it is flagged rather than guessed at. The wiki spells that key item 'Weapons Training Guide'; the client's is 'weapon training guide', so the client's spelling is written here. Bullet 5 is four levels of routing advice, but its deepest sub-bullet is the only place the ??? at (G-9) is named, so the spawn step is sourced to it. 'Axe skill 240+' has no slot in the schema and nothing observable behind it; 'Level 71' is a plain level gate on any job.

notes: A clean cutscene chain with two real evidence points in the middle of it. Bullet 1 is a shouted precondition, not a step -- without The Curious Case of Melvien nothing happens at all -- and it merges into the first Roskin talk. Bullet 6 is split: examining the cache a second time spawns the NM, killing it drops the hat, and those are a spawn and a kill. Bullet 7 is a third examine of the same cache, so the Well-Kept Cache carries four separate rungs; that is what the page describes and each one is a real click. The Weathered Haverton hat is the NM's drop and therefore the fight's evidence, and the Forgotten memory is the third examine's -- neither is a reward, so both are usable. The quest's own reward -- a necklace or bayld -- is not evidence and is not used. The '== Optional ==' heading sits inside the walkthrough rather than after it and its bullet keeps the numbering at 12, so it is the same section; it is recorded as an optional step that consumes the hat, which is why the fight's evidence stops being true if you take it. Header start has no grid; bullet 2 gives Roskin's as (H-8) and that is used. Palomel gets no grid ref anywhere, only 'near Scouts' Coalition'. Fame reads 'Adoulin', which is not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing.

notes: Seven bullets, seven steps, and the page is careful about which era each one is in -- it writes '(S)' where it means the past and leaves it off where it does not, so bullets 1 and 2 are present-day Southern San d'Oria and Upper Jeuno while bullets 4 and 7 are Grauberg (S) and Southern San d'Oria (S). Both parenthesised forms resolve, so they are kept as written. Bullet 3's 'Windurst Waters North' is the north half of zone 238 and not a zone of its own, so it is recorded as Windurst Waters. Bullet 4 carries three nested alternative routes into Witchfire Glen -- Campaign Arbiter warp, the Glimmer of Hope Conflux shortcut, and a Lightsworm blue ??? by a Cavernous Maw -- all of which are ways to arrive, not steps, and none of which changes what you trade or where. Bullet 5 is a genuine action but an unobservable one: zone out and let a game day pass, and the addon sees neither the zoning nor the clock. The Fey stone is the only evidence in the quest; the Large memory fragment on bullet 7 is the header's Reward, and on top of that the client has more than one key item by that name, so it is not used.

notes: The whole substance of bullet 3 is in a wikitable: six foods in the left column, and where to buy or cook each in the right. The right column is shopping advice and not steps, but the left column is a real, fully named, fully resolvable AND-list, so it becomes an obtain step whose evidence is holding all six at once -- one of the few places in this batch where the addon can actually see progress. The trade at bullet 4 then consumes them, so the ladder falls back on the session latch for the last two steps; nothing after that is observable. The sub-bullet under bullet 4 is doing the reader a favour and me one too: 'Looking Glass Legends' is neither an item nor a key item, just text, so there is deliberately no evidence on the hand-in. Bullet 1's 'zone after the previous quest' is a precondition and its Fellow Points aside is a warning, neither a step. notes:
Two bullets, two talks, one NPC, and the entire difficulty of the quest is in a requirement that cannot be written down. Brygid picks a body piece and a legs piece at random from the pool for whichever job you approach her as, so there is no item to name and nothing to hold that the page states; items stays empty rather than guessing. items_partial is set on the second step because the page does describe an alternative it cannot enumerate -- HQ (+1) versions satisfy the request as well as the base pieces. The Empyrean Armor gate is real (at least one original piece worn, not an iLvl 119 upgrade) but equipment is not something the addon inspects, so it is flagged and gates nothing. Both steps are on the same NPC and consecutive, which is one marker, and that is right: the whole quest happens at (D-11). The sub-bullets are all tactics -- unequip your body and legs first so she is less likely to name something you do not own, and quitting via her dialogue clears the quest from the log so you can rezone and reroll. The trailing 'Zoning is required in order to repeat this quest' is a repeat condition, not a step. Fame 'aalt' is an Abyssea zone code, not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing even with FLevel 2.

notes: Nine bullets and three of them are one step: bullets 2, 3 and 4 are a single journey from Conflux #7 to a specific spot on the western cliff and a controlled fall into a hole, with no named entity anywhere in them, so they merge into one travel step inside Abyssea - Uleguerand rather than becoming three unmarkable rungs. Bullet 8 is the way home afterwards, not a step. Bullet 6 is the quest: three waves of two or three falling NPCs that you target and talk to or examine, and the page never names a single one of them, so the target is honestly none and the wave count is nothing the addon can see. That leaves an unmarkable rung wedged between two Perfaumand (A) steps, which normally I would avoid -- but the page really does put the whole rescue between speaking to him and speaking to him again, and bullet 7 says the second one is mandatory before leaving. Nothing in this quest is observable: no key item, no item, no drop. The trailing 'Zoning is required in order to repeat this quest' is a repeat condition and the youtube tag is a link, neither a step.
